entities.summary: Michael Edmund Burke was an American lawyer and Democratic politician from Beaver Dam, Wisconsin. He served three terms in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing east-central Wisconsin from 1911 to 1917. He previously served four years each in the Wisconsin Senate and Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Dodge County, and was mayor of Beaver Dam from 1908 to 1910.
